The
Dag Hammarskjold Library
at
United Nations Headquarters
in
New York
is
a
library
designated
to
facilitate
the
work
of
the
United Nations
and
focuses
mainly
on
the
needs
of
the
UN
Secretariat
and
diplomatic
missions
.
Anyone
with
a
valid
United Nations Headquarters
grounds
pass
,
including
specialised
agencies
,
accredited
media
and
NGO
staff
,
is
able
to
visit
the
library
.
Due
to
security
constraints
in
place
at
the
United Nations Headquarters
complex
,

library
is
not

to

general
public
.
